verdict.rationale: Anytype documents its own controls over where data lives. Content is stored locally on-device (offline-first). A local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely. Users can also self-host a sync/backup network using a team-maintained Docker image, which places data on infrastructure in whatever location they choose. Caveats: there is no region picker for Anytype's managed backup nodes, and switching network mode requires exporting and re-importing into a new identity. missing for 10: region/residency selection for Anytype-hosted backup infrastructure, a smooth migration path between storage modes, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted residency.
